verdict.rationale: OpenFeature provider support is a fair question for a feature-flag vendor like Statsig, but nothing in the evidence pack mentions OpenFeature or a vendor-neutral flag API. The "StatsigProvider" in the docs is Statsig's own React wrapper component, not an OpenFeature provider. The OpenTelemetry mention concerns telemetry ingestion, so neither counts toward this story.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can use the vendor through OpenFeature providers so my flag code isn't locked to one vendor's SDK API
